headline: *Mixed close* as pharma shines
subline: Nifty edged up 0.23% while Sensex dipped slightly.
hero_text: Despite the lack of clear catalysts, the Nifty 50 closed higher driven by strong performance from the pharma sector.

why.title: Catalyst Absence
why.desc: No clear reasons for today's moves.

sector_reasons.Nifty Pharma: Strong sectoral gains drove market sentiment.
sector_reasons.Nifty Energy: Broad stability with no major moves.

bonus_text: Today, Nifty Pharma surged 1.66%, outshining other sectors.
movers_note_gainers: Top gainer was HDFCLIFE with a 5.05% jump, leading the pack.
movers_note_losers: ONGC led the losers with a 1.85% drop, followed by others.
watch_text: Keep an eye on BOJ's policy rate decision and ECB President Lagarde's speech tomorrow.
lessons: Nifty 50 edged up 0.23% despite no clear catalyst.
The pharma sector led the market with a 1.66% rise.
FII outflows maintained pressure on market sentiment.
DII inflows provided significant market support.
alert_text: BOJ Policy Rate decision and ECB speech on Friday.
cta_sub: Market insights and updates delivered daily.
next_text: Watch for market reactions to BOJ and ECB events on Friday.
